title: Florida Greenways & Trails System Plan
description: The statewide plan identifies priority corridors for trail development. The Bluffline corridor is designated as part of the larger Gulf Coast trail network connecting communities across the Panhandle.

title: Long Range Transportation Plan 2045
description: The region's federally-mandated transportation plan identifies multimodal corridors and prioritizes projects that improve safety for people walking and biking.

title: Bicycle & Pedestrian Master Plan
description: This regional plan specifically identifies the Bluffline corridor as a priority for investment, with recommendations for facility types and connection points.

title: Reimagine Jackson Street Plan
description: This joint city-county plan envisions a transformed Jackson Street corridor with improved multimodal connections, supporting the Bluffline's goal of connecting West Pensacola to downtown.

title: Warrington CRA Plan
description: The Warrington Community Redevelopment Area plan outlines the vision for transforming Jackson Lakes into a public park, a cornerstone of the western Bluffline corridor.

title: Strive to Thrive 2035 Strategic Plan
description: The City's strategic plan emphasizes quality of life, connectivity, and neighborhood revitalization—priorities that the Bluffline directly supports.

title: Waterfront Framework Plan
description: This plan guides development along Pensacola's waterfront, including connections between downtown and the bay—a critical link in the Bluffline corridor.

title: Urban Core CRA Plan
description: The Community Redevelopment Area plan identifies trail connectivity and waterfront access as priorities for neighborhood revitalization in downtown Pensacola.

title: Westside CRA Plan
description: The Westside Community Redevelopment Area plan prioritizes improved connectivity to employment centers and safe routes for residents without vehicle access.

title: Pensacola Bay Scenic Highway Corridor Master Plan
description: The northeast segment of the Bluffline follows the Pensacola Bay Scenic Highway corridor. This master plan provides a framework for preserving and enhancing the corridor's natural and historic character while improving multimodal access.
